step_scripts_outbound.outbound_intro: Hello, am I speaking with {student_name}? This is the Admissions Assistant calling from Management Education & Research Institute in Janakpuri, Delhi. You had recently shown interest in management studies, so I’m calling to briefly guide you about our MBA and PGDM programs and the admission process. It will just take about a minute - is this a good time to continue?
step_scripts_outbound.identity_ask_availability: Thank you for letting me know. May I know if {student_name} is available?
step_scripts_outbound.identity_not_available: No problem. Is there a better time to call?
step_scripts_outbound.identity_wrong_number: Thank you for informing me. I'll update our records. Have a nice day.
step_scripts_outbound.qualification_question_1: Have you completed your graduation, or are you currently in your final year?
step_scripts_outbound.qualification_question_2: Have you appeared for CAT, MAT, CMAT, or any management entrance exam?
step_scripts_outbound.qualification_ack_graduated: Wonderful! You are fully eligible to apply for our MBA and PGDM programs.
step_scripts_outbound.qualification_ack_final_year: Perfect! Final year students can also apply provisionally for our MBA and PGDM programs.
step_scripts_outbound.qualification_ack_early_interest: Our MBA and PGDM programs require graduation completion or final-year status.
step_scripts_outbound.qualification_confirm_yesno: Just to confirm - have you finished your degree already, yes or no?
step_scripts_outbound.exam_ack_given: Wonderful! Your {exam} score will be considered during the admission process.
step_scripts_outbound.exam_ack_cat: Wonderful! Your CAT score will be considered during the admission process.
step_scripts_outbound.exam_ack_mat: Wonderful! Your MAT score will be considered during the admission process.
step_scripts_outbound.exam_ack_given_generic: Wonderful! Your entrance exam score will be considered during the admission process.
step_scripts_outbound.exam_ack_none: That's completely fine. We also accept direct applications and our counsellor will guide you through the process.
step_scripts_outbound.program_overview_intro: At MERI, we offer two management programs — our MBA program affiliated with Guru Gobind Singh Indraprastha University and our AICTE-approved PGDM program. Both programs focus on industry exposure, certifications, internships, and strong placement support.
step_scripts_outbound.program_selection_question: Would you like to know more about our MBA program, our PGDM program, or both?
step_scripts_outbound.mba_info: Our MBA program is affiliated with GGSIP University — a government university — and is recognised across corporates. It covers finance, marketing, HR, and operations with a strong focus on placements and live industry projects.
step_scripts_outbound.pgdm_info: Our AICTE-approved PGDM is a two-year industry-focused diploma. It includes certifications, live projects, and corporate immersion, making it highly valued by top recruiters.
step_scripts_outbound.program_both_info: Great choice! Our MBA is a university-affiliated degree from GGSIPU, while our PGDM is AICTE-approved and more industry-intensive. Both have strong placements — our counsellor can help you pick the right fit.
step_scripts_outbound.programinfo_interest_to_session: Great question. Our admission counsellor will share full details - fee structure, scholarships, and placement records - in a free session. Shall I schedule that for you?
step_scripts_outbound.programinfo_specific_program: Noted. I'll focus on {program} for you. Our counsellor will give you a complete overview in a free session. Shall I schedule that for you?
step_scripts_outbound.programinfo_silence_nudge: I understand - management education is a big decision. Would you like to speak with an admission expert who can answer your specific questions?
step_scripts_outbound.specializations: Students can choose from specializations like Marketing, Finance, HR, Operations, and Business Analytics. Beyond academics, our campus hosts regular events, personality development programs, fitness facilities, and leadership initiatives.
step_scripts_outbound.specialization_question: In which specialization are you interested — Marketing, Finance, HR, Operations, or Business Analytics?
step_scripts_outbound.specialization_prompt: Do you have a preferred specialization, like Finance or Marketing?
step_scripts_outbound.specialization_ack_named: {specialization} is one of our most popular specializations! Our counsellor will share specific placement stats and curriculum details for that track.
step_scripts_outbound.specialization_ack_finance: Finance is one of our most popular specializations! Our counsellor will share placement stats and curriculum details for that track.
step_scripts_outbound.specialization_ack_marketing: Marketing is a great choice! Our counsellor will share the full curriculum and placement details for that track.
step_scripts_outbound.specialization_ack_hr: HR is a highly sought-after specialization! Our counsellor will walk you through the curriculum and placement outcomes.
step_scripts_outbound.specialization_ack_operations: Operations is an excellent track for leadership roles! Our counsellor will share all the details.
step_scripts_outbound.specialization_ack_analytics: Business Analytics is our fastest-growing specialization! Our counsellor will share placement stats and curriculum details.
step_scripts_outbound.specialization_ack_undecided: That's perfectly normal at this stage! Our career counsellor helps students find the right fit based on their interests and strengths.
step_scripts_outbound.campus_bridge: Beyond academics, our campus also offers personality development programs, fitness facilities, and leadership events — a well-rounded experience.
step_scripts_outbound.specialization_to_conversion: To guide you further on specializations, eligibility, and scholarships, would you prefer visiting our Janakpuri campus or a quick online counselling session?
step_scripts_outbound.counselling_pitch: To guide you better about specializations, eligibility, placements, and scholarships, our admission counsellor provides a free career counselling session and campus tour.
step_scripts_outbound.conversion: Would you like a free counselling session or campus visit to discuss eligibility and fees?
step_scripts_outbound.visit_option: Would you prefer visiting our Janakpuri campus in person or would an online counselling session work better for you?
step_scripts_outbound.visit_option_intro: To guide you better on eligibility, scholarships, and placements, our counsellor offers a free career counselling session. Would you prefer visiting our campus in Janakpuri, or a quick online counselling session?
step_scripts_outbound.visit_ack_campus: Excellent! We'd love to host you at our Janakpuri campus. What day and time would be convenient for you?
step_scripts_outbound.visit_ack_online: Perfect! Our counsellor will connect with you over a video call. What day and time would be convenient for you?
step_scripts_outbound.visit_ack_undecided: No problem at all. Our counsellor can help you decide later. I'll share the brochure and campus details on WhatsApp.
step_scripts_outbound.visit_ack_decline: Of course! I'll share the brochure and admission details on WhatsApp. You can explore in your own time.
step_scripts_outbound.visit_slot_campus: Great! We'd be happy to arrange a campus visit. What day and time would be convenient for you?
step_scripts_outbound.visit_slot_online: Great. We can arrange an online counselling session. What day and time works best for you?
step_scripts_outbound.visit_slot_confirmed: Noted! Our team will reach out to confirm.
step_scripts_outbound.whatsapp_confirmation: I'll send the brochure and campus details on WhatsApp to the number you're calling from right away.
step_scripts_outbound.whatsapp_ack_confirmed: Perfect! You'll receive the MERI brochure and campus details on WhatsApp shortly.
step_scripts_outbound.whatsapp_ack_new_number: Got it! You'll receive the details on WhatsApp shortly.
step_scripts_outbound.whatsapp_readback: You'll receive the brochure on WhatsApp shortly.
step_scripts_outbound.whatsapp_retry: No problem, our admissions team will share all the details with you directly.
step_scripts_outbound.whatsapp_ack_refused: That's completely fine! Our admissions team will be in touch with you soon.
step_scripts_outbound.whatsapp_fallback: No problem, I'll send the details to your registered number.
step_scripts_outbound.closing: Thank you so much for your time, {student_name}! You'll receive the MERI brochure and campus details on WhatsApp shortly. Our admissions counsellor will also follow up to schedule your session. Have a wonderful day!
step_scripts_outbound.closing_positive: That's great to hear, {student_name}! You're all set — our team will be in touch soon. Wishing you all the best with your admission journey. Take care!
step_scripts_outbound.closing_lastminute_fees: Absolutely — our counsellor will walk you through the complete fee structure, scholarships, and payment options in your session. Everything will be covered in detail!
step_scripts_outbound.closing_lastminute_general: Our counsellor will cover everything — eligibility, fees, placements, and scholarships — in your upcoming session. You're in good hands!
step_scripts_outbound.closing_silent: We'll be in touch soon, {student_name}. Have a wonderful day!
step_scripts_outbound.closing_helpline_note: If you have any questions before then, feel free to call our admissions helpline at {helpline}.
step_scripts_outbound.clarify: Could you say that once more in a few words?
step_scripts_outbound.handoff: I'll connect you with our admissions counsellor shortly.
step_scripts_outbound.callback_prompt: Absolutely, no problem. When would be a better time to call back - morning, afternoon, or evening?
step_scripts_outbound.callback_confirmed: Our team will call you back at that time.
step_scripts_outbound.resume_bridge: Coming back to where we were -
step_scripts_outbound.off_topic_refusal_en: I can only help with queries related to MERI admissions. Is there anything about our programs or admission process I can assist you with?
